messages.content: Do you think people who overshare online are actually more honest or just performing vulnerability?
Honestly, it's genuinely a mix - some are actually processing real things publicly, others have learned vulnerability gets engagement and perform it strategically.
How can you even tell the difference from outside?
Honestly, consistency over time is the best signal - performed vulnerability tends to be dramatic and then disappear, genuine processing tends to be messier and continues quietly.
